sql: SELECT course_id, student_id FROM registration WHERE grade IS NULL OR grade = ''
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender='Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN gender='Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM prof

SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability, T3.gpa FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T1.first_name='Merwyn' AND T1.last_name='Conkay'
SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T1.graduate_from='University of Washington'

SELECT T5.name, T5.credit FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN registration T4 ON T2.student_id=T4.student_id JOIN course T5 ON T4.course_id=T5.course_id WHERE T1.gender='Female' AND T1.teachingability=(SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof WHERE gender='Female')
SELECT T1.capability FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T2.type='RPG' AND T2.intelligence>=4
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T2.grade='B' AND T1.intelligence=3
SELECT T1.name FROM course T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.course_id=T2.course_id WHERE T2.grade='D'
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T1.salary='low' AND T2.gpa=3.5
SELECT CAST(SUM(sat) AS REAL)/COUNT(course_id) FROM registration WHERE grade='B'
SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T3.name FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T1.intelligence=5 AND T1.gpa<3
SELECT AVG(T1.capability) FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T2.gpa<2.5
SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T2.capability FROM student T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN registration T3 ON T1.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T3.grade IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id WHERE T1.salary='high' AND T2.teachingability=(SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof)

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.name='Statistical learning' AND T2.sat=4 AND T1.gpa=3.8
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.diff=3 AND T1.intelligence=2
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type='UG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type='RPG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM RA T1 JOIN student T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T1.capability<3
